Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614052. Join activities to assays, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614052, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
